result.summary: 本文提出“柏拉图式表征假说”，认为不同神经网络对数据的表征正在趋同，并最终趋向一个反映现实世界联合分布的共享统计模型 [abstract][S1.p4]。作者综述了跨架构、跨任务、跨模态乃至与大脑对齐的趋同证据，并报告了在78个视觉模型和多个语言模型上的对齐测量结果 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS3.p5]。作者提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种可能的选择压力来解释趋同 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2]，并给出一个理想化世界中对比学习收敛到PMI核的形式化分析 [S4.SS2.p4]。作者还讨论了该假说的含义、反例与局限，包括不同模态信息不等价、并非所有表征都在趋同、对齐度量存在争议等 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要探讨的问题是：不同神经网络模型对数据的表征是否正在趋同，这种趋同是否会持续，以及最终会收敛到什么 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者提出的核心假说是，这种趋同存在一个终点和驱动原则：不同模型都在试图得到对现实的表征，即生成观测数据的现实世界事件的联合分布 [S1.p4]。作者将这一趋同的表征称为“柏拉图式表征”，并指出其与科学哲学中的“收敛实在论”以及“安娜·卡列尼娜情景”相关 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: This paper explores one aspect of this trend: representational convergence.
What has led to this convergence? Will it continue? And ultimately, where does it end?
different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe
We call this converged hypothetical representation the “platonic representation” in reference to Plato’s Allegory of the Cave

The platonic representation hypothesis refers to the situation where we are in an Anna Karenina scenario and the “happy representation” that is converged upon is one that reflects a statistical model of the underlying reality.

method.text: 论文将表征定义为向量嵌入，并用其诱导的核（相似度结构）来刻画，将表征对齐定义为两个核之间相似度的度量 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。实验中使用互最近邻度量，即两个核诱导的k近邻集合的平均交集除以k [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。对于跨模态对齐，作者使用成对数据集（如图像-标题数据）作为桥梁，分别计算图像核和文本核并测量其对齐 [S2.SS3.p5]。此外，作者提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种假说来解释趋同 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2]，并在理想化世界模型下形式化地论证对比学习收敛到PMI核 [S4.SS2.p4]。

evidence.quote: We restrict our attention to representations that are vector embeddings. We characterize such a representation by the similarity structure it induces, referred to as its kernel.
we define representational alignment as a measure of the similarity of the similarity structures induced by two representations
we use a mutual nearest-neighbor metric that measures the mean intersection of the $k$ -nearest neighbor sets induced by two kernels
To measure cross-modal alignment, we use paired datasets to bridge the two modalities.
The Multitask Scaling Hypothesis There are fewer representations that are competent for $N$ tasks than there are for $M<N$ tasks.
The Capacity Hypothesis Bigger models are more likely to converge to a shared representation than smaller models.
The Simplicity Bias Hypothesis Deep networks are biased toward finding simple fits to the data, and the bigger the model, the stronger the bias.
Therefore, the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$ (up to a constant offset).

experiments.text: 在视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者评估了78个视觉模型，包括不同规模的ViT、ResNet-50和ResNet-18，训练目标涵盖分类、MAE、DINO、CLIP和对比学习等 [A3.SS1.p1]。这些模型在VTAB的19个分类任务上做线性探测，并在Places-365验证集上以k=10、1000个图像表征计算对齐 [A3.SS1.p2][A3.SS1.p3]。在跨模态对齐方面，作者比较了BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA等语言模型与多种ViT视觉模型，使用WIT数据集的1024个样本、k=10计算对齐 [A3.SS2.p1][A3.SS2.p2][A3.SS2.p3]。作者还进行了颜色共现案例研究，从CIFAR-10图像共现和语言共现中学习颜色表征并与CIELAB感知空间比较 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]，以及用DCI数据集改变标题密度来测试信息量对对齐的影响 [S6.F9][A5.p4]。

evidence.quote: We consider 78 vision models in total:
To test representation quality, we evaluate linear probing performance on all 19 VTAB classification tasks
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over $1000$ image representations computed on Places-365’s validation dataset
The language model families we consider are BLOOM, OpenLLaMA, and LLaMA.
For vision models, we consider ViT models of various sizes trained on various data and objectives.
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over 1024 samples from WIT (Wikipedia-based Image Text;)
We conduct a case study to verify that convergence does happen on real data.
We collect color cooccurrence statistics from the CIFAR-10 dataset
We vary caption length using the Densely-Captioned-Images (DCI) dataset.
we find that the alignment score also improves as caption length increases

findings.text: 作者发现，能力更强的视觉模型之间表征更对齐：在VTAB上表现更好的模型形成更紧密的聚类，而弱模型表征更分散 [S2.SS2.p2]。跨模态上，语言建模能力越强的LLM越倾向于与视觉模型对齐，反之亦然；CLIP模型因显式语言监督对齐更高，但在ImageNet分类微调后对齐下降 [S2.F3][S2.SS3.p5]。对齐还与下游性能相关：与DINOv2对齐更好的LLM在Hellaswag和GSM8K上表现更好 [S2.SS5.p1][S2.F4]。颜色案例研究表明，从图像共现或语言共现中学习都能恢复大致相同的感知颜色表征 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。此外，标题越密集（信息量越高），语言表征与对应图像视觉表征的对齐越好 [S6.F9][A5.p4]。

evidence.quote: The results indicate that models with high transfer performance form a tightly clustered set of representations, while models with weak performance have more variable representations.
The results show a linear relationship between language-vision alignment and language modeling score
However, this alignment decreases after being fine-tuned on ImageNet classification (labeled CLIP (I12K ft)).
the better an LLM is at language modeling, the more it tends to aligns with vision models
Figure 4 supports this hypothesis by demonstrating improved performance on commonsense reasoning (Hellaswag;) and mathematical problem solving (GSM8K;) as alignment improves.
learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation
With denser captions, the mapping may become more bijective, leading to improved language-vision alignment scores.
we find that the alignment score also improves as caption length increases

limitations.text: 作者承认，不同模态可能包含不同信息，两个模型若访问根本不同的信息就无法收敛到相同表征；其数学论证仅严格适用于Z的双射投影，对损失性或随机观测函数不成立 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。作者指出并非所有表征目前都在趋同，例如机器人领域尚无标准化的世界状态表征方式 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。作者还承认AI社区的研究者偏见和“硬件彩票”可能人为促成趋同 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]，且其论证只适用于被优化以完成许多任务的智能，专用智能可能不会趋同 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1]。此外，对齐度量本身存在争议，作者只重点使用互最近邻一种度量 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]；并且实验中对齐分数仅达到0.16（理论上限为1），这一差距是噪声还是重大差异仍未解决 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

evidence.quote: Two different models cannot converge to the same representation if they have access to fundamentally different information.
our mathematical argument in Section 4 only strictly holds for bijective projections of $\mathbf{Z}$
While we do expect other modalities will follow similar trends, we have yet to see the same level of convergence across all domains.
Researcher bias and collective preferences within the AI community have shaped the trajectory of model development.
Our argument only holds for intelligences that are optimized to perform well on many tasks.
there is active debate on the merits and deficiencies of all these ways of measuring alignment
alignment clearly increases but only reaches a score of $0.16$, according to our mutual nearest-neighbor metric. The maximum theoretical value for this metric is $1$.
We leave this as an open question.
